newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait share index up in busier week.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait share index up in busier week.

text.p: The Kuwait Stock Exchange (KSE) index rose 28.7 points to 2,447.5 during the week to Wednesday and trade volume and value rose compared to the previous week, figures released on Thursday show.
Daily average for value of traded shares rose to 54.4 million dinars ($180 million) from 42.2 million. Volume rose to a daily average of 185 million shares from 142 million, KSE figures show.
Gainers led losers 34-17, while 18 shares did not move.
Investment firms were the most active sector in terms of traded value with 85 million dinars, followed by property firms with 73 million and industrials with 48 million.
Only nationals of Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates, Qatar, Oman and Kuwait -- can trade on the exchange. Foreign residents can invest in mutual funds.
